days.title: Peaks and Glacial Lakes
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Tre Cime di Lavaredo
stops.detail: The park is renowned as many famous Dolomite peaks are located within it, among which the north faces of the Tre Cime di Lavaredo stand out.

stops.name: monte Paterno
stops.detail: Other important peaks are the Punta dei Tre Scarperi (3,152 m), Monte Popera (3,046 m), Croda dei Baranci (2,922 m), Monte Paterno (2,744 m), Cima Una (2,698 m), Cima Undici (3,092 m) and Croda dei Toni (3,094 m).

stops.name: lago dei Piani
stops.detail: Above this layer there are layers of riebl, grey dolomite and clayey marls, which allowed, for example, the formation of the Piani lake.

stops.name: forte Haideck
stops.detail: In the territory of the park there is an Austrian fort from the First World War, fort Haideck.

stops.name: lago di Landro
stops.detail: The only significant lake in the park is the Landro lake.
